authorization.reason: The packets preserve the requested gameplay readers and cost controls, but candidate freezing, runtime prerequisites, tool authority binding, suite-plan validation, and recoverable scratch preservation are not yet fail-closed equivalents of the approved T3 tools.

review_harness_setup_failure.error: Initial preserved-wrapper invocation was rejected before attempt creation because the reviewer omitted the required {evidenceDir} child-argv placeholder. The corrected invocations above are the packet self-check evidence; this setup failure is not attributed to either packet.

n94_and_n97_exact_state_diagnostics.qualification: This remains trustworthy only after the candidate-binding and tool-authority blockers below are corrected.

blockers.finding: Freeze readiness is sentinel-based rather than schema-based. Values such as null, an arbitrary string, or malformed objects for independent_review and focused_test_receipt are treated as no longer pending and are copied into the candidate binding without verifying path, bytes, hash, receipt schema, review verdict, or reviewed candidate head.
blockers.impact: A clean committed candidate can become runnable without the required independent review and focused-test proof.
blockers.required_correction: Define and validate exact freeze-input schemas. Require independent review and focused-test receipt records with existing paths, byte/hash matches, expected schemas and passing verdicts, and exact candidate/base bindings before creating candidate-binding.json. Keep PENDING, missing, malformed, stale, or non-passing inputs fail-closed.

blockers.finding: The candidate delta gate permits every unreviewed docs/** and logs/** path. The authorized candidate is the three reviewed implementation files plus the specifically authorized pre-edit plan path, so broad directory exemptions do not freeze the reviewed candidate.
blockers.impact: Unreviewed canon, acceptance, evidence, or continuity changes can enter the committed candidate without blocking qualification.
blockers.required_correction: Require the exact authorized delta. Every allowed path, including the pre-edit plan, must be named and hash-bound in reviewed_files; reject every other changed path.

blockers.finding: assertCandidate trusts the ignored candidate-binding.json after checking only candidate_head, current HEAD/cleanliness, tools, critical inputs, retained runs, and prior attempts. It does not validate binding schema/base_ref, recompute and compare the committed base-to-head delta, revalidate reviewed_files, or revalidate the independent-review and focused-test evidence recorded at freeze.
blockers.impact: The ignored binding can be edited or replaced without making Git dirty, allowing a forged or stale freeze to pass campaign and full-suite readiness.
blockers.required_correction: At every assertCandidate call, validate binding schema/base/head; recompute and exactly compare delta paths/bytes/hashes; validate reviewed_files against the delta; and re-read/re-hash/revalidate the independent review and focused-test receipt. Bind candidate-binding.json itself into downstream full-suite readiness by content hash.

blockers.finding: The T3 candidate preflight's active native-process query and rejection were removed.
blockers.impact: Qualification may run concurrently with an AWWV/Electron/native process that can mutate shared runtime files or contaminate evidence.
blockers.required_correction: Restore the fail-closed active-process check at freeze/assert or campaign preflight, and retain its proof in the preflight evidence.

blockers.finding: The full-suite startup no longer proves the exact Git Bash and jq paths/versions and no longer rejects forbidden AWWV_872/AWWV_880 control or finalization-injection variables.
blockers.impact: A known Windows shell-resolution hazard or inherited control variables can alter suite execution after the expensive run begins.
blockers.required_correction: Restore the exact Git Bash/jq prerequisite proof and fail-closed forbidden-variable check before launching the suite, recording the proof in opening evidence.

blockers.finding: The fresh suite plan is counted but not validated as exactly four parallel shards with the required single partitioned sector test. The opening gate therefore omits the T3 partitioned_four_cases assertion.
blockers.impact: A malformed or changed test plan can run and produce counts without proving the intended unchanged suite topology.
blockers.required_correction: Require parallel.length === 4, arrays of the expected shape, and partitionedFiles exactly [tests/sector_partition_buildCorpsFrontSectors_integration.test.ts] before suite launch. Record and gate the assertion.

blockers.finding: The new tool binding omits suite authorities and executables retained by the T3 contract, including the closed-suite report parser, default/balanced Vitest runners, receipt tools, duration baseline, suite inventory, package files, tsconfig, and Vitest config. Several of these are ignored or execution-defining and are not protected by the current Git-clean check.
blockers.impact: The full suite can execute or be interpreted through unbound changed tooling while still reporting candidate stability.
blockers.required_correction: Restore an exact contract manifest or equivalent freeze/assert records for every executable, parser, config, baseline, inventory, package file, and candidate/qualification authority consumed by the qualification and full-suite packets. Revalidate all hashes immediately before and after each run.

blockers.finding: Opening and closing scratch roots are fingerprinted but are not copied into a recoverable preservation archive. The former opening_exact, closing_exact, and copied-snapshot comparison gates were replaced by scratch_unchanged only.
blockers.impact: If the suite mutates or removes scratch evidence, the packet can detect drift but cannot preserve the opening and closing trees needed for diagnosis and audit.
blockers.required_correction: Restore exclusive opening and closing scratch/telemetry archival copies, verify each copy byte-for-byte, compare the two snapshots, and gate opening_exact, closing_exact, and scratch_preserved in the result.

blockers.finding: Qualification readiness checks a passing wrapper/result/summary and candidate path agreement, but does not explicitly require result.checks all true, summary.expected_head equal to the requested head, or the recorded supplemental critical bindings equal to the currently asserted bindings.
blockers.impact: A malformed or stale ignored qualification artifact can satisfy the condensed readiness expression after the candidate-binding weakness is exploited.
blockers.required_correction: Require the exact expected head in result and summary, every required result check true, exact candidate path/tree, and exact supplemental binding equality. Revalidate the qualification receipt and candidate binding by frozen hash at full-suite opening and closing.

required_before_any_expensive_run: Correct TR-TOOL-001 through TR-TOOL-009 without changing gameplay acceptance criteria.
Run syntax and JSON checks again.
Run preparation-only self-checks into new exclusive evidence directories.

Demonstrate negative self-tests for malformed review/receipt inputs, extra docs/logs delta, edited ignored binding, active native process, wrong shell/jq, malformed four-shard plan, changed bound suite tool, and scratch-copy mismatch.
Obtain one targeted independent correction verification against the corrected hashes.
correction_gate.stop_rule: Do not launch qualification or full suite until the targeted correction verification returns GO. Preserve any cheap-check failure and do not repeat unchanged review cycles.

notes: The retained gameplay acceptance readers, n91-n97 preservation, supplemental terrain bindings, exact candidate inventory, 35-minute caps, and no-retry policy are directionally correct and should be preserved during correction.
No campaign, suite, engine, build, package, browser, native app, or source modification was performed by this review.
The previously settled implementation review was not repeated.
